input.quote: (d) Neither party may assign this Agreement or any rights and obligations under this Agreement to any third party without the written consent of the other party.
input.rationale: Section 20(d) imposes a blanket assignment prohibition on both parties with no affiliate or M&A successor carve-out for us and no reasonableness standard on consent — the playbook walk-away position. Section 3(c) compounds this by separately barring Sparkling from assigning absent Garman's written consent, and Section 2 grants only a "non-transferable" licence. There is no change-of-control termination or re-pricing right elsewhere (Section 17 has no such trigger), so the fix is to add the affiliate/successor carve-out for us, a reasonableness standard for other assignments, a bar on Garman assigning to our competitors, and express confirmation that our change of control gives Garman no termination, suspension or re-pricing right. Section 3(c) is conformed by cross-reference.

proposal.summary: Add affiliate/successor assignment carve-out for Sparkling, reasonableness standard on consent, no competitor assignment by Garman, and no Garman right arising on our change of control
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added the customary carve-out allowing us to assign to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets without consent, confirmed no Garman right arises on our change of control, and made consent for other assignments subject to a reasonableness standard with no assignment by Garman to our competitors. As a fallback we can accept mutual assignment to successors on written notice with consent for other assignments not unreasonably withheld.

ops.oldText: (d) Neither party may assign this Agreement or any rights and obligations under this Agreement to any third party without the written consent of the other party.
ops.newText: (d) Except as expressly permitted below, neither party may assign this Agreement or any rights and obligations under this Agreement to any third party without the written consent of the other party, which consent shall not be unreasonably withheld or delayed. Sparkling may assign this Agreement, without the consent of Garman, to an affiliate of Sparkling or to a successor in a merger, acquisition, reorganization or sale of all or substantially all of its assets or shares, and no such transaction or change of control of Sparkling shall constitute a breach of this Agreement or entitle Garman to terminate, suspend or re-price this Agreement. Garman may not assign this Agreement to a competitor of Sparkling.
